specification.outcome: When a user asks in normal conversation to create an ordinary ticket, Tiber publishes an unclaimed Backlog task without requiring or changing a campaign.

scenarios.name: create a ticket without a campaign
given: the signed task board is writable
the create-task request contains an exact title and description accepted by the existing task value parsers
then: the host generates a version-4 task UUID, event UUID, and canonical UTC occurrence time
it publishes the existing schema-version-1 task-created event through GitTaskRemote
the result is an unclaimed unspecified Backlog task with the requested metadata and no campaign provenance

scenarios.name: preserve campaign independence
given: no campaign checkpoint exists or an unrelated campaign is active
then: the same ordinary task-created event is published
no campaign checkpoint is read, created, or changed
the task is not classified as a campaign goal

scenarios.name: deny invalid or unavailable task publication
given: the request is malformed, task values are invalid, or signed task authority is read-only
then: the host returns TIBER_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID, TIBER_TASK_VALUE_INVALID, or TIBER_TASK_BOARD_INVALID respectively
no task, readiness, claim, worktree, or campaign event is published

scenarios.name: route natural-language creation directly
given: the user asks Pi to add or create a ticket
then: it uses create-task rather than campaign-goal or begin-task
the tool result reports the generated task ID and final projected state

acceptanceCriteria: The closed workflow request shape is exactly {kind:'create-task',title:string,description:string}; unknown, missing, null, and wrong-typed fields are rejected.
Title and description use the existing parseTaskTitle and parseTaskDescription behavior without new normalization or limits.
Event construction remains host-owned; model input cannot select identifiers, occurrence time, campaign provenance, readiness, ordering, claim, or publication effects.

GitTaskRemote retains its existing signed linear fast-forward publication, concurrent retry, verification, and degraded-read-only behavior; this slice adds no alternate publication or compatibility path.
A successful result includes the exact generated task ID and shows Backlog, unspecified, and unclaimed state.
Ordinary task creation neither requires nor mutates FileCampaignStore state.
exclusions: Creating and specifying in one request
Automatically reviewing, ranking, claiming, or starting the new task
Changing GitTaskRemote publication or recovery semantics
Changing campaign scheduling or campaign-goal behavior
dependencies: src/core/tasks/task-values.ts existing task metadata and UUID values
src/core/tasks/task-board.ts existing task-created event and projection
src/extension/workflow-request-tool.ts deterministic dispatch and result capture
specification.architectureImplications: Add one closed create-task request interpreted by the existing signed task publication shell. Inference supplies title and description only; the host generates authority values and does not invoke campaign, readiness, or work transitions.
